name: benchmark-longmemeval_small_session
description: A small-session variant of a long-context meme evaluation dataset assessing multimodal understanding of memes across extended conversational sessions. It evaluates models' ability to interpret combined image+text memes for attributes like sentiment, humor, or intent within longer interactions. Geared toward long-context multimodal reasoning research rather than large-scale benchmarking.
reputation: Small, niche dataset with limited adoption used mainly for exploratory multimodal research.
